### Our Final Journey
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-february-7-2021.html
Passage: Micah 2:10
Points:
- The time approaches when every person must leave behind this life and embark on their final journey.
- Though the journey of death is unknown, believers can face it without fear because God is with them.
- Passing from this earthly life brings the Christian into the Father's home to dwell forever with Jesus.
- Meditating on the glory of heaven helps Christians endure earthly suffering and press faithfully forward.
